title: devendraea minuta
intro: Devendraea minuta, commonly known as the Himalayan tree turmeric, is a type of plant found in the Himalayan region. It is a perennial herb that belongs to the ginger family and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Devendraea minuta include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gingerols, shogaols, and turmerones, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-arthritic, and anti-cancer properties.
